items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And then there was John Simmons and Gaskin and Jimmy Butts wasn't too bad in there, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, carrying on, you know, so Curly Bailey and I, we managed to just go from one -- one club to the other. whoever when we went in there, they had one of those drummers, you know, until it started to getting, you know, other a little bass players could make it. Now, there were other bass players on the streets, you know, including Pettiford, who did lots of work with those guys. Pettiford wasn't as strong in the rhythm section, but it didn't bother him what they were doing. He could walk right on through it…
And then there was John Simmons and Gaskin and Jimmy Butts wasn't too bad in there, you know.
